prior_iterations.critique: The render clearly has white, soft-edged, readable large flakes over a suitably dark grey-blue background. However, the flakes read more like strongly bloomed circular light orbs than snow: their cores are heavily blown out and halos are oversized. This reduces the sense of individual soft snowflakes. The supplied view does not provide a visible second time sample to confirm the intended slow downward fall and subtle lateral wandering.
